finish_summary: Discrepancies between cart module and spec: apply_discount lacks rounding, bulk_discount_percent incorrect for quantity=50 (returns 5 instead of 10), parse_coupon rejects whitespace/case, Cart.total returns 0 on empty cart rather than shipping fee 60, Cart.items yields wrong structure leading to unpacking errors, remove_item raises KeyError for missing items instead of ValueError, add/remove accept zero/negative quantities silently. All these caused the test failures.
